scoring_justification: Hidden true total energy per atom for the 15 test structures cannot be embedded (not available from the paper); full recompute from predictions.csv is infeasible. Use T0 result-level compare of agent-reported RMSE against paper gold.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported test RMSE for total energy/atom with XRD descriptor and Grid Search CV (0.28 eV/atom) from Table 1.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the published paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Verbatim reproduction of the paper's headline reported value.

outputs.description: Per-sample predicted total energy per atom for the 15 test structures. The checker will recompute RMSE against hidden true values and score the reproduction based on the recomputed metric.

The agent-reported test RMSE. The checker verifies that this value meets or exceeds the hidden threshold (the paper-reported RMSE with tolerance) and is consistent with the recomputed RMSE from predictions.csv.

output_contract.notes: Task covers only the total energy/atom prediction using XRD descriptor and Grid Search CV, as scoped from the paper. Formation energy and packing fraction predictions are omitted to keep the task minimal.

steps.description: Validate predictions.csv structure and numeric sanity (rows, columns, value range).
Score agent-reported RMSE against paper gold: full credit if ≤ 0.33 eV/atom, then monotonic partial decay as RMSE rises beyond.
